name: Dianbo Yeyin Meng
source:
No matter how long you’re gone, there will always be a girl waiting for you in the same place. This is a story about forgetting, and about waiting. After countless restarts and countless memories lost… how long will you stay with her this time?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4222340]Steam[/url]]
translation:
无论你离开多久，总会有一个女孩在同一个地方等你。这是一个关于遗忘、关于等待的故事。无数次的重启，无数次的记忆丢失……这一次你会和她在一起多久？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4222340]Steam[/url]]
